description: Identify and list the traditional 4Ps of the marketing mix (product, price, place, and promotion) and their original definitions as coined by Neil Borden and E. Jerome McCarthy
Analyze the current state of the marketing mix, including any expansions or modifications to the traditional 4Ps, such as the addition of people, process, and physical evidence
Examine the role of digital marketing channels (such as social media, email, and search engine optimization) in the modern marketing mix, including their impact on traditional marketing channels
Investigate the challenges and limitations of implementing a marketing mix strategy, including issues related to resource allocation, measurement, and coordination across different marketing channels

Research the future outlook of the marketing mix, including emerging trends and technologies (such as artificial intelligence, personalization, and omnichannel marketing) that are likely to shape the marketing mix in the next 5-10 years
